Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AXP.
We delivered record revenue of $17.1 billion this quarter, representing 5% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $17.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
Operating income reached $5.6 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 174 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 391 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Revenue guidance of $17.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
